notes.title: New version available!
notes.notes:
at the request of players who haven't finished the game, and also those who want to upgrade all units to the maximum, the game has increased the rewards for repeated completion of missions: x5.8 for the final level and x4.5 for the rest;
 fixed the achievement "Upgrade all soldiers to maximum.".

notes.title: Version 1.171009 available!
notes.notes:
- 'Noise' effect can be turned off.
- Jamming in mission 1-10 fixed.
- Jamming in the end of mission 2-2  fixed.
- Swarm Queen battle simplified.
- Final battle in mission 2-10 fixed.
- Soldier healing effect became better visible.
- Special ability activation buttons fixed.
- Elite soldier's special ability fixed.
- Other minor fixes and improvements.
